gen-gf-gabarito-gf-bpmf-huninn: Gabarito draws its letters as if with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the shapes flow outward. And Bpmf Huninn keeps a modern sans feel underneath, with a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std reads as a plain sans with approachable curves that swell only slightly, its counters staying open to the outside. Gabarito, by comparison, is all monoline.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cairo: Gabarito leads with a nib-drawn look and terminals cut open, so its counters flow outward. Cairo follows in the body, a modern sans with a wide channel into every bowl, easy going over a long passage.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cairo-play: A bent-paperclip look with no swelling gives Gabarito its odd, expressive charm. Cairo Play takes over for the reading, with open round letters that stay clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cambay: Gabarito's strokes look like spaghetti, all one width. Cambay brings a contemporary plain sans below, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle, so the page gets one loopy voice up top and a quieter, slightly broken-ringed one beneath.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cantarell: Loose, nib-drawn and a bit cheeky, Gabarito opens its terminals so the counters flow outward. Cantarell sits next to it feeling approachable and neutral.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-catamaran: Gabarito has a rounded-nib look with no swelling at the stroke ends, and its terminals are cut open. And Catamaran carries the text in curvy sans-serif letters that feel unclamped, so the two loosen up together.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Nib-drawn and open-ended, Gabarito has curves as thick as its straight stems. But Chiron Hei HK sits below it in a modern sans, its wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-commissioner: Commissioner reads smoothly as a plain sans, with no clogged curves and every stroke drawn at one thickness. But Gabarito is the one with expression, its nib-drawn shapes and open terminals doing the talking.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-didact-gothic: Open terminals that let the counters flow outward are what make Gabarito stand out. Didact Gothic is the sans that never snags on a closed-up bowl, each stroke carrying the same visual weight.
